#' Plot a Mixture Component
#' 
#' @param x Input data
#' @param mu Mean of component
#' @param sigma Standard deviation of component
#' @param lam Mixture weight of component
plot_mix_comps <- function(x, mu, sigma, lam) {
  lam * dnorm(x, mu, sigma)
}

#creating a combined column
data_g_combined_Libp <- data.frame(
  LogFC_5g = annotated_5g_1Libp$fold_change,
  LogFC_13g = annotated_13g_2Libp$fold_change, 
  LogFC_21g = annotated_21g_1Libp$fold_change, 
  LogFC_29g =annotated_29g_2Libp$fold_change
)

# Calculate additional columns
data_g_combined_Libp <- data_g_combined_Libp%>%
  mutate(
    avgFC = (LogFC_5g + LogFC_13g) / 2,
    varFC = (LogFC_5g - avgFC)^2,
    sdFC = sqrt(varFC),
    `cDNA..` = annotated_5g_1Libp$`cDNA..`,
    `pro..` = annotated_5g_1Libp$`pro..`,
    Mutation.type = annotated_5g_1Libp$Mutation.type,
    Mutcode = annotated_5g_1Libp$Mutcode,
    ClinVar = annotated_5g_1Libp$ClinVar, 
    Donor_1_diff = LogFC_5g-LogFC_21g, 
    Donor_2_diff = LogFC_13g-LogFC_29g, 
    HDRT = annotated_5g_1Libp$GAACAATCAGTGGATTATAGACATAAGTTCTCCTTGCCTAGTGTGGATGGaCAGAAACGCTACACGTTTCGTGTTCGGAGCCGCTTTAACCCACTCTGTGGAAGTGCTCAGCATTGGAGTGAATGGAGCCACCCAATCCACTGGGGaAGCAATACTTCAAAAG)

#######quick comparison graphs########


#________________-Long time gDNA
# Calculate the correlation
correlation_14daygDNA <- cor(data_g_combined_Libp$LogFC_21g, data_g_combined_Libp$LogFC_29g)

# Plot with ggplot2
ggplot(data_g_combined_Libp, aes(x = LogFC_21g, y = LogFC_29g)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Mutation.type)) +
  labs(
    title = "14 DAY Donor 1 vs Donor 2 gDNA",
    x = "Donor 1",
    y = "Donor 2",
    caption = bquote(rho == .(correlation_14daygDNA))
  )+geom_smooth()


#________________-Short time gDNA

  geom_point(aes(color = Mutation.type)) +
  labs(
    title = "3 DAY Donor 1 vs Donor 2 gDNA",
    x = "Donor 1",
    y = "Donor 2",
    caption = bquote(rho == .(correlation_3daygDNA))
  )+geom_smooth()

#________________-Donor 1 short vs Long

# Plot with ggplot2

  geom_point(aes(color = Mutation.type)) +
  labs(
    title = " Donor 1: 3 vs 14 day gDNA",
    x = "Donor 1 :3 day",
    y = "Donor 1: 14 day",
    caption = bquote(rho == .(correlation_Donor_1_gDNA))
  )+geom_smooth()

#decay plot
ggplot(data_g_combined_Libp, aes(x = LogFC_5g, y = Donor_1_diff)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Mutation.type)) +
  labs(
    title = " Donor 1: 3 vs 14 day gDNA",
    x = "Donor 1 :3 day",
    y = "change from day 3 to 14")+geom_smooth()

#decay plot by position

  geom_point(aes(color = Mutation.type)) +
  labs(
    title = " Donor 1 gDNA: 3 vs 14 day change by position",
    x = "gDNA position",
    y = "change from day 3 to 14")+geom_smooth()

    x = "gDNA position",
